display_long_description:
**Step Into the Abyss. Claim Your Legend.**

Vaelorys is under siege. Fight back against invading hordes of monsters in this dark fantasy VR ARPG inspired by loot-driven classics like Diablo and Path of Exile.

[media]

Explore dungeons and untamed wilderness, wield powerful gesture-based magic, hunt for legendary loot, and build your hero as you fight to reclaim the realm.

[media]

**⚔️ Immersive VR Combat & Spellcasting**

Don't just press a button. Use your own hands.

Punch to unleash devastating attacks, strike from range, control groups with area effects, and defend yourself with powerful magic. Master 30+ spells and find the combinations that fit your playstyle.

[media]

**🎒 Loot, Gear & Character Builds**

Slay monsters, explore hidden corners, and hunt for rare gear and weapons. Upgrade your equipment, increase your power and shape your own build. That perfect drop could be just around the next corner.

[media]

**🔥 Progression & Exploration**

Earn experience, level up, unlock new abilities, and grow stronger as you venture through hostile wilderness filled with monsters, challenges, and rewards.

[media]

**👹 Epic Boss Battles**

Face powerful enemies and towering bosses. Learn their attacks, master your spells, and defeat them to claim their rewards and continue the fight for Vaelorys.

Vaelorys is being built alongside its community. Share feedback, report bugs, suggest features, and help shape the game as it grows.

**The dungeons are calling. Will you emerge as a legend, or become another skeleton in the dark?**

Join us: https://discord.gg/RprhzVkgAa
